title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 14 Red River Avenue North in Cold Spring, Minnesota, as the "Officer Tommy Decker Memorial Post Office".
official_summary:
(This measure has not been amended since it was introduced. The summary of that version is repeated here.)

Designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 14 Red River Avenue North in Cold Spring, Minnesota, as the "Officer Tommy Decker Memorial Post Office."

summary.headline: Congress named the Cold Spring, Minnesota, post office at 14 Red River Avenue North the "Officer Tommy Decker Memorial Post Office."
summary.what_it_does: This law gives a specific U.S. Postal Service building in Cold Spring, Minnesota, an official honorary name. The name honors Officer Tommy Decker. The law does not change postal services, hours, mail delivery, or staffing.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on December 16, 2014.
